messages:
linh: Heads-up — I pushed a docs PR updating the Vega13b model card with new seq_limit and benchmark numbers. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/842
sara: saw it, thanks. quick q: do we still support KV-prefix caching on the q4_0 quantized variants? The compat table currently says 'partial' which is ambiguous.
linh: good catch. runtime change last month means q4_0 supports prefix KV but only for <4k context due to an attention-kernel fallback — I'll clarify that in the notes.
james: can we add a short SDK snippet showing streaming + quantized variant usage? PMs are asking for an example they can drop into apps.
linh: plan: add under "SDK examples" with a tiny snippet like `client.responses.create({ model: 'vega13b-q4_0', input: prompt, stream: true })` and show `max_new_tokens` and `max_context` hints.
ashley: also, the catalog entry still lists `max_sequence: 16384` — benchmarks show throughput drops a lot past 8192. Please set `max_sequence` to 8192 and add a note about degraded perf >8k.
deploy-bot: preview generated for PR 842 — https://deploys.redwood-internal/preview/842 (will expire in 7d)
sara: for benchmarks — ops asked to include p50/p95/p99 latencies in the table for SLA evaluation. Can we add those columns?
james: yup — add p50/p95/p99 and list tokens/sec + ms. Also annotate hardware: A100-80GB, batch sizes used.
linh: I'll import the run from 2026-02-11 and annotate bench metadata. adding a short table plus raw CSV link.
ashley: heads-up: compatibility note links to /runtime/legacy-kernel (404). Replace with /runtime/kernel-fallbacks and add a one-liner about kernel fallbacks for quantized models.
linh: noted — fixing links + leaving reviewer TODO comments in the PR.
sara: QA flagged a sample prompt that produces very long outputs — added a comment to show `max_new_tokens: 512` in examples to prevent runaway token counts.
james: I'll tidy the examples for brevity and ensure the snippet uses the SDK v3 param names.
ashley: also add a migration note for Dedicated customers who pinned the float16 variant — call out that migrating to q4 variants will change cold-start characteristics and prefix-cache behavior.
linh: will add a short Migration section: "If you're pinned to v1-ff16, to migrate see steps + config toggles; test on staging to validate latency SLOs."
sara: quick review request — can someone take a look? need to merge before the docs cut tomorrow.
james: I'll review examples + bench table in ~30m.
ashley: I'll review compatibility & migration wording after james.
linh: thanks all — after approvals I'll merge and backfill changelog. small dev note: remember to update catalog JSON (catalog/models/vega13b.json) to include `supported_quantizations: ["fp16", "q4_0"]` and `kv_cache_support: "partial (prefix up to 4k)"`.
sara: perfect. once merged QA will re-run smoke check on the preview.
james: LGTM when tests pass. :thumbsup:
ashley: merging after james' sign-off. :shipit:
linh: merged and published. closing thread.
